issues: Activated ability is missing the "Lesson (1)" additional cost; it should require both [cost02] and Lesson (1) before granting this follower Storm. Implement a cost/effect primitive for Lesson counters or lesson payment so this can be encoded.

Strike ability is encoded as dealDamageAllEnemies for 2 to all enemies, but the source says "Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader"; it should damage enemy leaders only, not followers. Implement an ability to deal damage to each enemy leader, or a target/effect form that supports all enemy leaders.

Fanfare is incorrectly wrapped as optionalCost; the source text makes "Lesson (3), discard 2 Passion cards" mandatory, not optional. It should be encoded as a required additional cost on the fanfare ability before dealing 6 to each enemy follower and drawing 2. Implement support for mandatory additional costs on triggered abilities, including Lesson payment.

Fanfare only encodes "Bury the top 3 cards of your deck" and is missing all three follow-up clauses: if you buried a Cute card, heal your leader 2; if you buried a Cool card, give this Assail; if you buried a Passion card, give this +2 attack.

The missing follow-up clauses depend on what traits were among the cards buried by this specific mill effect; implement post-mill conditions/effects that can check whether a buried set included a card with a given trait so the three conditional rewards can be encoded correctly.

Fanfare incorrectly uses dealDamageAllEnemies for 3, which would hit followers too; the source says "deal 3 damage to each enemy leader". It should damage enemy leaders only. Implement an ability to deal damage to each enemy leader, or a target/effect form that supports all enemy leaders.

onDamaged ability is missing the condition "takes at least 5 damage"; it should only increase your max play points by 1 when this follower takes 5 or more damage at once. Implement an onDamaged threshold condition or event payload comparison to encode damage amount >= 5.

Fanfare conditions are encoded using ownCemeteryTraitMin checks after milling, but the source requires checking whether the 3 cards buried by this effect included Cute/Cool/Passion cards specifically. It should not trigger based on preexisting cemetery contents.

Implement post-mill conditions/effects that can check whether a card with a given trait was among the cards buried by this specific mill effect, then use those conditions for heal 2 / grant Assail / +2 attack.
